His boots are fully sculpted, but his unitard and the hair on his chest is all just painted on.
the sculpt of the face is so recognizable that there's no mistaking who this is. He's incredibly angry - maybe because his beard is just painted on, not sculpted.
he also has joints at the head, shoulders, biceps, elbows, wrists, waist, hips, thighs, knees, shins and ankles.

The Giant comes with an accessory. It's not much - just a black softgoods nWo shirt - but it's more than we expected. The back closes with velcro, and there are no sleeves, so it's very easy to fit on him.
